title: Source Index for Same-Whole Fractions, Units, and Checks
topics: Equal-part fractions: the denominator names the unit and the numerator counts selected units.
Equivalent fractions: 1/2 = 2/4 = 3/6 using the same positive-integer scaling.
Same-whole addition: 1/2 + 1/3 = 3/6 + 2/6 = 5/6; adding denominators gives the wrong unit.
Checks and models: positive-addend sum bounds; label the whole and show equal-sized parts.
conditions: Fractions must refer to the same whole before their quantities can be compared; if the original wholes differ, first describe their sizes.
Equivalent fractions require multiplying both numerator and denominator by the same positive integer, which changes the partition but not the quantity.
A drawn model should label the whole and show equal-sized parts; a correct numerical answer with an unexplained unit still needs a reasoning check.
